extracted.intended_audience: writers, critics, and readers interested in heroism, leadership, and historical/character portrayal
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for recognizing, portraying, and judging 'heroes' (historical or literary): emphasis on sincerity, organic forms, practical action, and the relation between public reception and heroic efficacy. Useful for writers of historical/biographical essays and character studies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sincerity over hollowness
rubrics_metrics.description: Hollowness, insincerity _has_ to cease; sincerity of some sort has to begin.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Insist on truth even when it is terrible ('a Truth clad in hell-fire'). Anti-patterns: diplomacy, expediency, and polite falsehoods that preserve semblance at the cost of reality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hero-worship as social necessity
rubrics_metrics.description: To me... that of 'Hero-worship' becomes a fact inexpressibly precious; the most solacing fact one sees in the world at present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat reverence for genuine heroes as a stabilizing, perennial social force; in writing, foreground the cultural and moral necessity of recognizing exemplary figures when they appear.

rubrics_metrics.name: Universal scope of hero-worship
rubrics_metrics.description: Hero-worship exists forever, and everywhere: not Loyalty alone; it extends from divine adoration down to the lowest practical regions of life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Show how heroism ranges from religious veneration to everyday courtesy and loyalty; examples include courtesy and religious worship as manifestations of the same impulse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Heroes as makers of Order
rubrics_metrics.description: Every Great Man, every genuine man, is by the nature of him a son of Order, not of Disorder... He is here to make what was disorderly, chaotic, into a thing ruled, regular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Portray heroic figures as agents who impose order and purpose on chaos (carpenter metaphor). Anti-pattern: presenting heroes primarily as anarchic destroyers without constructive aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forms should grow organically
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms which _grow_ round a substance, if we rightly understand that, will correspond to the real nature and purport of it; forms which are consciously _put_ round a substance, bad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When depicting institutions, ceremonies, or character mannerisms, prefer organically evolved forms that fit the inner reality of the subject. Anti-pattern: artificially imposed ceremonies or mannerisms that feel staged.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural spontaneity in ceremonial forms
rubrics_metrics.description: There must be a veracity, a natural spontaneity in forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid 'set speeches' and grimacing politeness in scenes of genuine feeling. Example of anti-pattern: 'upholsterer-mummery'—a man mechanically performing rites for someone else's grief; show instead authentic, spontaneous expression.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer raw reality to dignified semblance
rubrics_metrics.description: The nakedest, savagest reality, I say, is preferable to any semblance, however dignified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In portraying religion, grief, or conviction, value bare, intense authenticity over polished ceremonial fiction. The text advises confidence that 'Given the living man, there will be found clothes for him'—i.e., genuine inner life will generate fitting form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recognize sincerity to discern heroes
rubrics_metrics.description: Know the men that are to be trusted: the sincere alone can recognize sincerity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasize that discerning true greatness requires a receptive, sincere audience; caution against a reflexive scepticism that mistakes genuineness for fraud. Method: look for internal consistency and conscience rather than surface polish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conscience as essential to greatness
rubrics_metrics.description: Can a great soul be possible without a _conscience_ in it, the essence of all _real_ souls, great or small?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When judging or portraying a 'great man', prioritize evidence of conscience and moral seriousness. Anti-pattern: accepting calumny or surface-based accusations instead of searching for moral motive and inner sincerity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical insight and focus on facts
rubrics_metrics.description: He drives towards the practical and practicable; has a genuine insight into what _is_ fact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attribute to heroes an eye for fact and effective action (e.g., Cromwell's advice to choose substantial yeomen and the creation of the 'Ironsides'). Anti-pattern: leaders who only balance abstract expediencies and never grasp practical truth.

rubrics_metrics.name: Action and courage over eloquence
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtue... is not fair-spoken immaculate regularity; it is first of all... Courage and the Faculty to _do_.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value 'tugend'—the capacity to act—above rhetorical skill. In characterization, show deeds and moral toughness rather than polished speech as the core of heroism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allow inarticulacy in prophetic figures
rubrics_metrics.description: The inarticulate Prophet; Prophet who could not _speak_. Rude, confused, struggling to utter himself...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not mistake inarticulacy or roughness of manner for lack of depth; many prophetic or visionary figures are poor formal speakers but powerful in prayer, action, and extempore utterance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spiritual/communal deliberation as legitimate method
rubrics_metrics.description: All his great enterprises were commenced with prayer... They used to assemble, and pray alternately, for hours, for days, till some definite resolution rose among them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represent prayer, communal deliberation, or other non-rational methods as genuine ways heroes seek guidance and form purpose; avoid dismissing such practices as mere hypocrisy without examining their fruits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prefer substance over polished constitutional respectability
rubrics_metrics.description: Smooth-shaven Respectabilities... step along in their stately way... the heart remains cold before them; the fancy alone endeavors to get up some worship of them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be wary of honoring measured, decorous figures who elicit admiration only on stylistic grounds; dramatize the emotional, raw, and chaotic figures who stir real human response (e.g., Cromwell vs Pym).

rubrics_metrics.name: Moral conscience, not material grievance, justifies revolt
rubrics_metrics.description: Really, it seems to me the one reason which could justify revolting, this of the Puritans... Not _Hunger_ alone produced even the French Revolution; no, but the feeling of the insupportable all-pervading _Falsehood_.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In portraying rebellion or revolution, center the moral/ spiritual grievance (annihilation of moral self, enforced falsehood) rather than merely economic complaints, unless those economic conditions embody larger existential falsehoods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beware surface calumny and sceptical misreading
rubrics_metrics.description: A superficial unbelieving generation only, with no eye but for the surfaces and semblances of things, could form such notions of Great Men.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When assessing historical characters, avoid accepting popular calumnies based on surface appearances; require concrete proof before labeling a hero false. Example: sustained refusal to find a single clear falsehood in Cromwell despite accusations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Semblance must correspond to reality
rubrics_metrics.description: Semblance, I assert, must actually _not_ divorce itself from Reality. If Semblance do,--why then there must be men found to rebel against Semblance, for it has become a lie!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In narrative and criticism, insist that outward forms, ceremonies, and public roles should transparently reflect inner truth; when they do not, represent the resulting tensions and rebellions as inevitable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Balance skepticism with the ability to recognize true leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: "Detect quacks"? Yes do, for Heaven's sake; but know withal the men that are to be trusted!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advocate a double competence: be rightly suspicious of impostors but not so fearful of being duped that one rejects genuine greatness. Practical advice: first seek truth and sincerity, then deploy critical detection.
